data.title: Automated Mule Account Creation Velocity
data.description: Detect automated account opening patterns indicative of mule account infrastructure buildout: (1) multiple applications originating from the same device fingerprint or IP address within a 24-hour window, (2) KYC document metadata anomalies such as identical creation timestamps or template-based formatting, (3) application completion in under 2 minutes suggesting automation, (4) absence of mouse movement or scroll events with rapid sequential field completion indicating bot-driven form filling.

detection.condition: selection_speed or selection_velocity or (selection_bot and selection_document)

enrichment_required.source: Device intelligence enrichment (application count per device fingerprint in 24h)
Document analysis enrichment (metadata consistency and template detection)

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Automated Mule Account Creation Velocity")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:account_onboarding
(application_duration_seconds<120 OR mouse_events_count=0 OR scroll_events_count=0)
| stats count as app_count dc(applicant_id) as unique_applicants values(applicant_id) as applicants
  avg(application_duration_seconds) as avg_duration min(application_duration_seconds) as min_duration
  sum(mouse_events_count) as total_mouse_events by device_fingerprint ip_address
| where app_count>3 OR (avg_duration<120 AND total_mouse_events=0)
| eval risk_level=case(app_count>10, "critical", app_count>5, "high", app_count>3, "medium")

falsepositives: Legitimate batch account opening by businesses or payroll providers
Accessibility tools that bypass standard mouse interaction
Corporate onboarding processes using automated form-filling
